wait_time: a few hours to four days
format: single JSON or TXT file, chosen when you request

steps.title: Open your profile, then Settings and privacy
Choose all data rather than a selection
steps.detail: Selecting only some categories has been reported to drop watch history entirely. All data avoids the problem.

steps.title: Pick JSON, not TXT
steps.detail: JSON keeps the structure. The TXT version is easier to read by eye and holds noticeably less.

steps.title: Request the file
steps.detail: It is prepared in the background; there is no email link to wait for.

steps.title: Collect it from the Download data tab
steps.detail: You are notified in the app when it is ready. The file is available for four days and then deleted.

notes: No media of any kind is included. Your own videos, your profile picture and anything sent in a message are all URLs pointing back at TikTok.
The last day or two of activity is usually missing, because of how far behind the export runs.
Everything is in one file. For a heavy account that is tens of megabytes of JSON in a single document.

faq.q: Are my TikTok videos included in the data download?
faq.a: No. The export contains links to your videos rather than the files. The same is true of anything you liked or saved, and of media in messages.

faq.q: Should I choose TXT or JSON for a TikTok export?
faq.a: JSON. The TXT version is meant to be read by a person and is much harder for any tool to use, and by several accounts it contains less.

faq.q: Why is my TikTok watch history missing?
faq.a: Requesting only some categories rather than all data has been reported to omit it. Request everything and it comes back.

faq.q: How long is the TikTok download link valid?
faq.a: Four days from when it is ready. After that the request has to be made again.
